ranked.title: Chronic forecast bias present in historical data
Forecast miss inherited from Region level

checks.clause: KPI: Forecast Adherence formula + threshold recorded
KPI: breach flag agrees with |adherence| > threshold
Root causes: multiple explanations, ranked, capped at 5
Root causes: each carries description, evidence, confidence, impact, action
Root causes: best-supported first (confidence descends, except mandated-first causes)
Confidence: percent AND High/Medium/Low, consistent with each other
Hypothesis engine: status is Verified or 'Hypothesis - To be Validated'
Skeptic mode: challenges recorded with verdicts
Business language: no statistics vocabulary in business-facing text
Technical metrics kept in their own (collapsed) section
Output format: executive summary, KPI status, business impact all present
Core principle: observations exist separately from the ranked cause
Temporal: prior week / last 4 / last 13 / same week last year computed
Investigation order: higher levels checked before concluding
Investigation order: an inherited miss is actually reported as inherited
CQN validation: channel migration evaluated before blaming the forecast
Correlation analysis: relationships retained/rejected on evidence
Critical rules: no invented campaigns / product launches asserted
Critical rules: every quoted figure traces to the real data
Critical rules: gaps declared rather than glossed over
Action recommendations: every cause carries a practical action
